error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Egypt their registered SIM card will keep working for its full data-plan validity regardless of their visa or residency status

verdict.summary: Egypt's National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA) requires foreigners to register a SIM in person with an original passport and valid residency document, capped at 5 voice lines and 5 data lines per operator, and requires the operator to link the SIM's validity to the holder's residency period - the line is disconnected one month after residency expires unless a renewed residency document is provided. This is separate from the data-plan duration printed on the package.

dead_ends.action: Assume a registered Egyptian SIM keeps working through its full advertised plan validity even after the buyer's visa or residency permit expires
dead_ends.why_fails: NTRA's Mobile SIM Cards Sales Regulations for Individuals require operators to link SIM validity to the holder's residency period and disconnect the line one month after residency expiry absent a renewed residency document - deactivation is tied to immigration status, not the data plan.
dead_ends.condition: Registered foreigner SIM (not a short-term unregistered tourist SIM)
dead_ends.common_misconception: That once a SIM is activated, its validity is governed only by the operator's plan terms.

dead_ends.action: Try to register more than 5 voice lines or 5 data lines per operator on one foreign passport
dead_ends.why_fails: NTRA caps foreign customers at 5 voice lines and 5 data lines per mobile operator using a single passport; additional registrations are refused.
dead_ends.condition: Registering multiple lines on one passport

workarounds.action: Bring an original passport plus a valid residency document (or visa) to an operator branch in person and sign the contract on-site
workarounds.how: This is the route NTRA recognizes for a foreigner to get a registered line; the agent keeps a colored copy of both documents and the operator must verify the residency period is still valid.
workarounds.condition: Any foreigner obtaining a registered SIM

workarounds.action: Before your visa or residency document expires, bring the renewed document back to the operator to keep the line active
